1: #!/usr/bin/env bash
2: # =============================================================================
3: # OpenVela Huangshan Pi — Isolated Build Runner
4: # =============================================================================
5: # Usage:
6: #   ./run.sh [build|configure|shell|clean|image]
7: #
8: # Commands:
9: #   image     — Build the Docker image (toolchain + build tools baked in)
10: #   build     — Run isolated CMake + Ninja build for lckfb_huangshan_pi/nsh
11: #   configure — Create/update build-output and run CMake configure only
12: #   shell     — Drop into interactive shell inside the isolated container
13: #   clean     — Remove build artifacts and image
14: #
15: # Security guarantees:
16: #   --network=none          No network access
17: #   --read-only             Root filesystem read-only
18: #   --no-new-privileges     Cannot gain new privileges
19: #   --cap-drop=ALL          All Linux capabilities dropped
20: #   -v SRC:RO               Source tree mounted read-only
21: #   No -p / --publish       No ports exposed
22: #   No --privileged         Not privileged
23: #   No -v /var/run/docker.sock   No Docker socket
24: # =============================================================================
25: set -euo pipefail
26: 
27: SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
28: REPO_ROOT="$(cd "${SCRIPT_DIR}/../.." && pwd)"
29: 
30: IMAGE_NAME="openvela-huangshan-build"
31: CONTAINER_NAME="openvela-huangshan-build"

33: # ---- Board configuration (verified Huangshan Pi parameters) ----

35: CMAKE_GENERATOR="Ninja"
36: EXTRA_FLAGS="-Wno-cpp -Wno-deprecated-declarations"
37: CUSTOM_MODULE_PATH="/opt/openvela-cmake"
38: 
39: # ---- Paths inside the container ----
40: SRC_MOUNT="/openvela/src"
41: BUILD_DIR="/openvela/build"
42: CACHE_DIR="/openvela/cache"
43: ARTIFACTS_DIR="/openvela/artifacts"
44: 
45: # ---- Host-side output directories ----
46: HOST_BUILD_DIR="${SCRIPT_DIR}/build-output"
47: HOST_CACHE_DIR="${SCRIPT_DIR}/cache"
48: HOST_ARTIFACTS_DIR="${SCRIPT_DIR}/artifacts"
49: 
50: # ---- Helper: Docker security flags (shared by all commands) ----
51: SECURITY_FLAGS=(
52:     --network=none
53:     --read-only
54:     --no-new-privileges
55:     --cap-drop=ALL
56:     --security-opt=no-new-privileges:true
57:     --tmpfs /tmp:rw,noexec,nosuid,size=256m
58:     --tmpfs /run:rw,noexec,nosuid,size=64m
59:     -v "${REPO_ROOT}:${SRC_MOUNT}:ro"
60:     -v "${HOST_BUILD_DIR}:${BUILD_DIR}"
61:     -v "${HOST_CACHE_DIR}:${CACHE_DIR}"
62:     -v "${HOST_ARTIFACTS_DIR}:${ARTIFACTS_DIR}"
63: )
64: 
65: # ---- Commands ----
66: 
67: cmd_image() {
68:     echo "==> Building Docker image: ${IMAGE_NAME}"
69:     docker build \
70:         -t "${IMAGE_NAME}" \
71:         -f "${SCRIPT_DIR}/Dockerfile" \
72:         "${REPO_ROOT}"
73:     echo "==> Image built successfully"
74: }
75: 
76: cmd_build() {
77:     echo "==> Starting isolated Huangshan Pi build"
78:     echo "    Source (read-only):  ${REPO_ROOT}"
79:     echo "    Build output:        ${HOST_BUILD_DIR}"
80:     echo "    Cache:               ${HOST_CACHE_DIR}"
81:     echo "    Artifacts:           ${HOST_ARTIFACTS_DIR}"
82:     echo ""
83: 
84:     # Ensure host output dirs exist
85:     mkdir -p "${HOST_BUILD_DIR}" "${HOST_CACHE_DIR}" "${HOST_ARTIFACTS_DIR}"
86: 
87:     # CMake configure + build in one container run
88:     docker run --rm \
89:         --name "${CONTAINER_NAME}" \
90:         "${SECURITY_FLAGS[@]}" \
91:         "${IMAGE_NAME}" \
92:         bash -c "
93:             set -euo pipefail
94:             echo '--- CMake Configure ---'
95:             cmake \
96:                 -B ${BUILD_DIR} \
97:                 -S ${SRC_MOUNT}/nuttx \
98:                 -DBOARD_CONFIG=${SRC_MOUNT}/${BOARD_CONFIG_REL} \
99:                 -DCUSTOM_MODULE_PATH=${CUSTOM_MODULE_PATH} \
100:                 -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER_LAUNCHER=ccache \
101:                 -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_LAUNCHER=ccache \
102:                 -DEXTRA_FLAGS=\"${EXTRA_FLAGS}\" \
103:                 -G${CMAKE_GENERATOR}
104: 
105:             echo '--- Ninja Build ---'
106:             cd ${BUILD_DIR}
107:             ninja -j\$(nproc)
108: 
109:             echo '--- Copy artifacts ---'
110:             cp -a ${BUILD_DIR}/nuttx.bin ${ARTIFACTS_DIR}/ 2>/dev/null || true
111:             cp -a ${BUILD_DIR}/nuttx ${ARTIFACTS_DIR}/ 2>/dev/null || true
112:             cp -a ${BUILD_DIR}/nuttx.manifest ${ARTIFACTS_DIR}/ 2>/dev/null || true
113:             cp -a ${BUILD_DIR}/compile_commands.json ${ARTIFACTS_DIR}/ 2>/dev/null || true
114:             echo '==> Build complete'
115:         "
116: }
117: 
118: cmd_configure() {
119:     echo "==> Starting isolated Huangshan Pi configure"
120:     echo "    Source (read-only):  ${REPO_ROOT}"
121:     echo "    Build output:        ${HOST_BUILD_DIR}"
122:     echo "    Cache:               ${HOST_CACHE_DIR}"
123:     echo ""
124: 
125:     mkdir -p "${HOST_BUILD_DIR}" "${HOST_CACHE_DIR}"
126: 
127:     docker run --rm \
128:         --name "${CONTAINER_NAME}-configure" \
129:         "${SECURITY_FLAGS[@]}" \
130:         "${IMAGE_NAME}" \
131:         bash -c "
132:             set -euo pipefail
133:             echo '--- CMake Configure ---'
134:             cmake \
135:                 -B ${BUILD_DIR} \
136:                 -S ${SRC_MOUNT}/nuttx \
137:                 -DBOARD_CONFIG=${SRC_MOUNT}/${BOARD_CONFIG_REL} \
138:                 -DCUSTOM_MODULE_PATH=${CUSTOM_MODULE_PATH} \
139:                 -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER_LAUNCHER=ccache \
140:                 -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_LAUNCHER=ccache \
141:                 -DEXTRA_FLAGS=\"${EXTRA_FLAGS}\" \
142:                 -G${CMAKE_GENERATOR}
143:             echo '==> Configure complete'
144:         "
145: }
146: 
147: cmd_shell() {
148:     echo "==> Dropping into isolated shell"
149:     mkdir -p "${HOST_BUILD_DIR}" "${HOST_CACHE_DIR}" "${HOST_ARTIFACTS_DIR}"
150: 
151:     docker run -it --rm \
152:         --name "${CONTAINER_NAME}-shell" \
153:         "${SECURITY_FLAGS[@]}" \
154:         "${IMAGE_NAME}" \
155:         /bin/bash
156: }
157: 
158: cmd_clean() {
159:     echo "==> Cleaning build artifacts"
160:     rm -rf "${HOST_BUILD_DIR}" "${HOST_CACHE_DIR}" "${HOST_ARTIFACTS_DIR}"
161:     echo "==> Removing Docker image"
162:     docker rmi -f "${IMAGE_NAME}" 2>/dev/null || true
163:     echo "==> Clean complete"
164: }
165: 
166: # ---- Main ----
167: case "${1:-build}" in
168:     image)      cmd_image ;;
169:     build)      cmd_build ;;
170:     configure)  cmd_configure ;;
171:     shell)      cmd_shell ;;
172:     clean)      cmd_clean ;;
173:     *)
174:         echo "Usage: $0 {image|build|configure|shell|clean}"
175:         exit 1
176:         ;;
177: esac
